[[File:Seeker_Hermit_FDSS.png|thumb|250px|An female Ithorian Jedi hermit]]
{{Quote|When I first met Obi-Wan, he'd been a hermit on Tatooine for ten years or more.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>}}
A '''hermit''' was any individual that retired from society and lived in a simple way apart from others. The habitation of a hermit was called a hermitage.<ref name="Before the Storm" /> Some hermits were hiding from the law, as was the case with [[Fegred Ewd]].<ref name="Ride Herd">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021205herd|text=Ride Herd|int=Ride Herd}}</ref> For a brief time in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] came to think that heremitism was a compulsory passage in the life of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] lest he or she would be tempted to seek power over others.<ref name="Before the Storm" />
